expression of CD 14 is accompanied by occurrence of cell death in PMN from heifer's mammary gland.
CD14+ PMNs are more susceptible to apoptosis and necrosis than CD14- PMNs in heifer mammary gland.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the expression of CD14, a marker of PMN activation, in relation to the occurrence of apoptosis in PMN from blood, mammary gland and in vitro cultivated PMN.
the role of CD14+ PMNs and their apoptosis in the inflammatory process of the bovine mammary glands.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the expression of CD14 is not a specific marker of apoptosis and necrosis in PMN from heifer blood, resident and inflammatory mammary gland cells.
the expression of CD14 on PMN is associated with the occurrence of apoptosis and necrosis in bovine PMN.
the expression of CD14 on PMN is associated with the occurrence of cell death, but not vice versa.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
expression of CD 14 is a sign of PMN activation and may be used to monitor the process of PMN activation in the mammary gland.

CD14 is a useful marker of PMN apoptosis.

CD14 expression in PMN from heifer udders is a marker of cell damage and may indicate a role for CD14 in the pathogenesis of mastitis.
